module_summary: AXI-stream synchronous FIFO: packed beats are written into a block RAM via write/commit pointers, read through a RAM output pipeline, with full/empty from pointer MSB comparison and optional frame-drop logic.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO RAM storing packed tdata/tlast/tuser words.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem; compared with rd_ptr for full.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem; advanced when pipeline pulls a word.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer visible to reader; defines empty.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer-MSB full detection deasserting s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Committed pointer equals read pointer; blocks read pointer advance.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Oversize-frame detection, used only in frame FIFO mode.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM output pipeline stages carrying read words to output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid chain of read pipeline stages; enables stage transfers.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word of tdata, tlast and tuser written to mem.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame drop in progress; active only with FRAME_FIFO/MARK_WHEN_FULL.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces tlast and bad tuser on frame truncated when full; parameter-disabled.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Oversize frame being passed through in frame mode; parameter-disabled.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame, used for marking.

anchors.name: depth_reg
anchors.why: Registered occupancy wr_ptr minus rd_ptr for status_depth.

anchors.name: overflow_reg
anchors.why: Overflow pulse on dropped frame end, driving status_overflow.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload packed into s_axis word.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid qualifying RAM writes.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full and drop configuration.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Input frame end stored with data and steering frame logic.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input user/bad-frame flag stored with data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload from last RAM pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from pipeline valid chain.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the read pipeline.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output frame end unpacked from pipeline word.

groups.name: FIFO RAM
groups.description: Block RAM of packed AXI words.

groups.name: Pointers and flags
groups.description: Write, commit and read pointers with full/empty and depth.

groups.name: Write/frame control
groups.description: Frame drop/mark/send flags and status pulses, mostly parameter-disabled.

groups.name: Read pipeline
groups.description: RAM output registers with valid chain feeding output port.

groups.name: AXI ports
groups.description: AXI-stream input and output handshakes and payload.
